records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The increase in revenue was primarily driven by higher volume in both segments.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: For the three months ended September 30, 2023, our OFSE segment recognized orders of $4.2 billion, an increase of $0.5 billion, or 13%, and our IET segment recognized orders of $4.3 billion, an increase of $2.0 billion, or 84% compared to the three months ended September 30, 2022.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: In the third quarter of 2023, we generated revenue of $6,641 million compared to $5,369 million in the third quarter of 2022, increasing $1,272 million or 24%.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The increase in income before income taxes was driven by higher volume and price in both segments and structural cost-out initiatives, lower restructuring and impairment charges, and a positive effect from the change in fair value on certain equity securities.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Total segment operating income increased $204 million, driven by growth in OFSE and IET.
